newsitem.title: USA: Raytheon unit gets $1.12 bln contract.
newsitem.headline: Raytheon unit gets $1.12 bln contract.

text.p: Raytheon said Tuesday its Raytheon E-Systems unit has won a five-year U.S. Department of Defense contract worth up to $1.12 billion.
The contract calls for the company to provide logistics suppport to the Special Operations Command at at least seven sites in Kentucky, Florida, North Carolina and California, it said.
The contract is an follow-on to an existing contract primarily being carried out in Lexington, Ky.

Services to be provided include maintenance, fabrication, modification and repair of maritime systems, fixed and rotary wing aircraft and aircraft systems, communications-electronics systems, weapons and other systems, it said.
"Winning this contract was an important part of our 1997b business plan," Raytheon E-Systems chairman and chief executive Lowell Lawson said in a written statement.
